herd_section_quoted: Restrict the closed-form anchor and the complete-network equivalence to q > 1/2.
Specify how zero-variance contrasts enter the Holm family and what "Holm-adjusted intervals" means.

amendments_applied.A-1: window-1 replaced by window-2 in EXP-002 and EXP-003 (P-1)
amendments_applied.A-2: analytic anchor and complete-network equivalence restricted to q > 1/2 (P-2, P-3)
amendments_applied.A-3: structurally degenerate (zero-variance) contrasts excluded from the Holm family, reported as exact comparisons (P-4)
amendments_applied.A-4: decisions on Holm-adjusted p-values (familywise 0.05); reported intervals are unadjusted 95% intervals; no simultaneous or 'Holm-adjusted' interval is claimed (P-5)
amendments_applied.A-5: planned sample kept: seeds 0 to 9, 1,000 episodes per seed and cell (P-6)
amendments_applied.where: research/protocol.md section 11; EXP-001 section 10, EXP-002 section 14, EXP-003 section 8
amendments_applied.note: The approval named the topics of A-3 and A-4 without choosing between the options of P-4 and P-5; the AI assistant chose them at the freeze (master prompt 11.3 item 8; existing implementation), before any confirmatory value was seen. The owner may revisit them only by a dated post-freeze amendment.

ratifications.herd_item_quoted: The agent's handling of zero-variance contrasts in the Holm family, and its interval definition.
ratifications.effect: The choices made by the AI assistant at the freeze for A-3 (zero-variance contrasts excluded from the Holm family, reported as exact comparisons) and A-4 (decisions on Holm-adjusted p-values; reported intervals are unadjusted 95% intervals; no simultaneous or Holm-adjusted interval claimed) are now owner decisions.
ratifications.hashes: unchanged: the ratified choices are already in the frozen v1.0 text; no protocol, config or code changed

common_decisions.C2: PDFs: built with pandoc and Typst (-V mainfont="Libertinus Serif"); no LaTeX on the machine.
common_decisions.C3: Authorship: "Mohamed Bechir Kefi", no affiliation. The AI is disclosed as a research and development assistant, not as an author.
common_decisions.C4: Disclosure: exploratory values of the primary contrast (paired accuracy difference against the independent baseline) were seen before the freeze, in runs EXP-001-R001 to R004 (listed below with their values and storage paths). R001 used master seeds 0 and 1, but only at N=20 (smoke matrix); episode streams are keyed by (master seed, q, network, v, N), so no R001 episode coincides with a confirmatory episode. R002 to R004 used master seeds 100 to 109, disjoint from the confirmatory seeds 0 to 9; R002 and R003 ran the EXP-002 and EXP-003 matrix shapes (with window-1) at one fifth of the planned episodes, and R004 ran the window-2 cells that A-1 introduces. These values motivated A-1 (window-1 degenerate) and confirmed the planning SD for A-5. They are not evidence for any hypothesis.
